scenarios.title: Late delivery
scenarios.summary: The order arrives one day after the promised date. The store's own signed emails prove it.
scenarios.store: confirms the order today and sends the delivery notice tomorrow

product.name: Parcel, express delivery
product.goes_wrong: It arrives one day after the promised date.

scenarios.title: Not as described, the store admits
scenarios.summary: A red sweater arrives green and the store admits the mistake.

scenarios.title: Not as described, the store disputes
scenarios.summary: An unlocked phone arrives locked. The store disputes with a fact twice, so the claim is not proven.
scenarios.store: disputes with a fact, then again in the closing round

product.name: iPhone 13, 128 GB, unlocked
product.goes_wrong: It arrives locked to a carrier.

scenarios.title: Not as described, no proof
scenarios.summary: A laptop arrives without its charger. The claim has no proof, the judge asks for it and none is sent.

product.name: Laptop, charger included
product.goes_wrong: There is no charger in the box, and no proof of it.

scenarios.title: Not delivered, the store says it shipped
scenarios.summary: The order never arrives. The store only says it shipped it.

scenarios.title: Not delivered, the store does not answer
scenarios.summary: The order never arrives and the store does not answer within the window.
